scope: Reference runner workspace isolation and cross-platform check entrypoint.
implementation_summary: Updated architecture docs before implementation to define workspaceRef as the source workspace and require a run-owned local Git worktree for default reference runner execution.
Changed run_workflow() so the default local workspace provider creates artifactDir/workspace as a Git worktree before invoking standard-harness or loop-engineering.
Recorded workspace.json as an isolated_workspace artifact with source workspace, effective workspace, branch, and base commit.
Changed manual resume to continue the effective workspace from the stored run result after validating the resume request matches the stored start request.
Exposed workspace.json through MCP run inspection.
Added python scripts/check.py as a cross-platform check entrypoint and made Makefile lint/test wrap it.

verification.summary: Passed; source repo value.py stayed VALUE = 1 while isolated workspace value.py became VALUE = 2.
Passed; manual resume continued the same isolated workspace and source repo stayed unchanged.
Passed; MCP start used isolated workspace and run inspection returned workspace.json.
Contract/AWKP lint passed and 34 unit tests passed.

known_limits: The reference runner retains isolated worktrees for review/resume; cleanup or garbage collection remains future operational work.
Custom injected workspace providers are assumed to enforce their own isolation semantics; this fix hardens the default local runner path.
